 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Upadhyay
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
The petitioner is in custody in connection with F.S. Case No. 01 of 2019 for the offenses under Sections 26(2) (1) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner in the instant case is that he has used substandard mirch powder in his restaurant.
Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the FSL report does not indicate that the mirch powder was found dangerous to life.
The petitioner is in custody since 17.01.2020.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

Let the petitioner, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.5944 of 2020(2) dt.03-02-2020 above named, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 50,000/- (Fifty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge II,
Banka, in connection with F.S. Case No. 01 of 2019.
However, in the event the petitioner is found involved in similar cases in future, the court below shall be at liberty to cancel the bail bonds of the petitioner in the present case.
